feeds.title: Paddling Magazine » Canoeing
feeds.description: Our magazine combines kayaking, paddle boarding, canoeing, and paddling water sports. We support the industry through great articles, brands, and adventures. Paddling Magazine also covers people, places, adventures, boats and gear, trends, and events happening in the industry.

feeds.title: Canoeing Ireland
feeds.description: Learn to kayak with our paddlesports skills training to stay safe on the water or explore the benefits of membership to Canoeing Ireland. The Irish Canoe Union T/A Canoeing Ireland was formed in 1960. The objective was to organize/assist in organizing and promoting competitive and recreational canoeing events and arrange and provide the holding instruction in canoeing skills and techniques, and the promotion of safety.

feeds.title: Nova Craft Blog
feeds.description: Nova Craft Canoe began in 1970 and believes in building canoes you can rely on, whether you're on the creek with your family or solo tripping in the heart of the backcountry. Our canoes marry tradition and innovation to bring you to the places you love most.

feeds.title: Bending Branches Blogs » Canoe
feeds.description: This section of our blog features articles that have to do exclusively with Canoeing. Some sub-topics may include but are not limited to Kayak, Paddleboard, and more. We build one of the finest quality canoe and kayak paddles in the world. Our paddles are designed and built for people who value every minute they spend on the water. Our paddles endure longer for both short-term and long-term expeditions.

feeds.title: Aqua Bound Blogs » Canoeing
feeds.description: We build paddles for recreational enthusiasts who value every minute they spend on the water. In 1991, Aqua-Bound was born in Surrey, British, Columbia manufacturing paddles for whitewater, touring and recreational kayaking, and canoeing. The paddles are still built here with the same passion for extraordinary quality and service.

feeds.title: Paddling Life » Canoeing
feeds.description: Canoeing's latest news and product reviews. Paddling Life keeps you informed on what's new in canoes, canoeing trips, canoe industry news, and much more. Paddling Life keeps its fingers on the sport's pulse through timely news coverage, event updates, profiles, gear reviews, video links, photo galleries, story links, and more. Our goal: is to support and grow paddlesports and keep the sport's stoke alive.

feeds.title: Freeranger Canoe Blog
feeds.description: Freeranger Canoe builds wooden canoes that combine traditional designs with modern epoxy composite technology. We also make a range of light and strong laminated wooden paddles. We organize canoe-building workshops for canoeists who want to experience this. This can be done individually or in a group.

feeds.title: Canoe the Wild Blog
feeds.description: Canoe the Wild offers canoeing adventures in Northern Maine and Eastern Canada for the beginner and seasoned paddler alike. Canoe trips are a great way to experience nature, view wildlife, learn a new skill, take pictures, catch a fish, have fun and connect with family and friends. Canoe the Wild is owned and operated by Dave Conley, Registered Maine Guide.

feeds.title: Taylor Statten Camps » Canoe Trip
feeds.description: Canoe trip adventures are a part of what makes TSC stand out from the rest. Years of experience in tripping and some of the best in Canada can be found here. The Taylor Statten Camps offer a fantastic summer camp experience by creating a warm and nurturing atmosphere in a safe and healthy environment. Campers participate in programmed activities and canoe tripping where they develop lifelong friendships. Campers gain an increased sense of self-confidence and maturity, but most importantly, they have a lot of fun.

feeds.title: Chiswick Pier Canoe Club Blog
feeds.description: Based in a superb setting on the River Thames at Chiswick Pier, Chiswick Pier Canoe Club was formed in 1999 and has around 60 members. It's a friendly club and offers taster sessions to members of the public at weekends. We are committed to developing all aspects of canoeing and kayaking and helping people to make more use of the Thames.

feeds.title: Canoeing Blog
feeds.description: The Ultimate Guide To Canoeing and Paddling Online. The website provides rapid, up-to-date research on canoe tripping and wilderness camping information- destinations, how to buy a canoe, and the appropriate gear- by linking users directly to the products and travel services of OEM manufacturers, outfitters, and local services.

feeds.title: The Banff Blog » Canoe
feeds.description: In this area of our blog, we aim to educate you about Canoe rental advice and activities. We're Cameron Seagle and Natasha Alden, and on this site, you'll find our experiences, photography, and informative travel guides from around the Canadian Rockies.

feeds.title: Board and Kayak Life » Canoe
feeds.description: On this website, you'll find all the best information on the latest kayak and stand-up paddle board gear and accessories. Board and Kayak Life offer the best in product reviews, destination guides, and other informational content related to kayaking, kayak fishing, paddle boarding, SUP fishing, canoeing, and anything that involves a paddle!

feeds.title: ScouterLife Blog » Canoeing
feeds.description: This section of our blog features articles that have to do exclusively with Canoeing. Some sub-topics may include but are not limited to Hiking, Backpacking, Kayaking, and more. ScouterLife is a collection of my life in scouting. I believe that scouting is an inspired program that helps boys become young men and eventually turns young men into great men and future leaders.

feeds.title: Eventum.lv Blog
feeds.description: Eventum.lv offers Canoe boats and kayaks for water tourism on the Latvian river as well as transport that will take you and the kayaks to the start of the route and pick up the boats when you finish the trip. We can advise the most suitable route for you, as well as give advice on choosing a trip.

feeds.title: Marathon Canoe Racing UK
feeds.description: Marathon Canoeing is a fun, but challenging endurance outdoor sport, happening across the country on rivers, lakes, and canals, a nature-rich environment you don't usually get to see from roads or footpaths. Canoe racing clubs offer a combination of the marathon, and shorter distance (sprint) racing, with practical coaching and club sessions to develop skills in racing kayaks and canoes.
